nodes.name: [D33-01] Receive Structured Request
nodes.notes: Day 33 test endpoint. Day 34 will add WhatsApp normalization before this same contract.

nodes.name: [D33-02] Normalize Core Input
nodes.notes: Produces the stable Day 33 request shape. It does not make booking decisions.

nodes.name: [D33-03] Validate Core Contract
nodes.notes: Rejects invalid structure before a database connection is used. PostgreSQL repeats authoritative checks.

nodes.name: [D33-06] Execute Atomic Core Action
nodes.notes: Select the Supabase PostgreSQL credential after import. The JSON export intentionally contains no credential ID.

nodes.name: [D33-08] Return Core Response
nodes.notes: Returns one JSON response for both valid and rejected paths.
